title: AWS Builder Center now available as mobile app on iOS and Android
summary: Discover more about what's new at AWS with AWS Builder Center now available as mobile app on iOS and Android
body_markdown:
AWS Builder Center is now available as a mobile app on iOS and Android. Builder Center brings together the global builder community with articles on trending topics, hands-on workshops with free sandbox environments, community spaces, events at Builder Lofts, access to 600+ AWS Skill Builder courses, and a Wishlist where builders can give feedback directly to AWS product teams. The AWS Builder app makes it easy to stay connected with millions of builders from anywhere.


With the app, you can browse articles, follow fellow builders, check Builder Loft event calendars, manage your Wishlist, and keep up with AWS Heroes, Community Builders, and User Group Leaders from your phone. Push notifications let you subscribe to the topics and communities you care about and get alerted when new content is published. Sign in with your AWS Builder ID and stay signed in across sessions.


The AWS Builder Center mobile app is available worldwide on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.


To learn more about the AWS Builder Center mobile app, visit the[AWS Builder Center mobile page](https://builder.aws.com/mobile) .
